title: Mid-Bay Watersports
specs: Explore Choctawhatchee Bay, Destin Harbor, Crab Island (pontoon boats only)
Waverunners top speed 47 mph, stable and comfortable ride
Operator must be 18 years or older with valid ID
Operator must have Florida Boater’s Safety Card or Nationally Recognized Boater’s Safety Card if born on or after Jan 1, 1988
Must be 18 years or older to rent with valid photo ID showing DOB
Must be 18 years or older to drive with valid photo ID showing DOB
Jetski operators must meet Florida statutes and have Boater’s Safety Card if born on or after Jan 1, 1988
Children must be at least 6 years old to ride as passenger on jetski, sit behind adult
Must have valid driver’s license to rent and drive jetski
Pets allowed with $100 security damage deposit
gap: Exact prices for all pontoon boat rental durations and seasons not fully detailed
blurb: Guests rent pontoon boats or waverunners to cruise around Choctawhatchee Bay, Destin Harbor, and nearby areas. Pontoon boats accommodate up to 12 passengers and cannot enter the Gulf of Mexico. Waverunners accommodate up to 3 passengers with a max weight of 400 pounds and can reach speeds up to 47 mph.
extraNote: No refunds for cancellations within 24 hours of reserved date · No shows charged in full · Damage deposit $500 per equipment charged to credit card on file · Mid-Bay Watersports may reschedule or cancel due to unsafe weather; vouchers or partial refunds offered · No early return refunds; late returns charged prorated hourly rate rounded up to next 15 minutes · Intoxicants prohibited; service refused if under influence · Kiosk located just east of Lulu’s at the foot of the Mid-Bay bridge in Destin.
